package.name: nros_board_freertos_posix
package.description:
FreeRTOS POSIX simulator board support for nano-ros (phase-370 W1).
The FreeRTOS kernel's `ThirdParty/GCC/Posix` port running on a Linux host: FreeRTOS tasks are pthreads, the scheduler is signal-driven, and the network stack is the host's rather than lwIP. That makes it the freertos family's first non-QEMU, CI-runnable end-to-end lane.
Descriptor-only, like the sibling `linux` board: there is no Rust board crate, because the cells this board carries are C and C++ (the FreeRTOS POSIX port has no Rust entry shape of its own — it reuses the family's). The package.xml must sit beside the descriptor, because that is where `descriptor_path()` looks.
